## setting
**36 run(s)** — rule `xiang22-setting` — 10.7717/peerj.12968  
*Methods, 'Plant materials and sample collection' and 'RNA extraction, library construction, and sequencing'*

> The varieties used in our study were 'Yu Gu 18' and 'Zhang Gu 13', grown in the EXPERIMENTAL STATION OF ANYANG ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURE SCIENCES (North China summer-sowing region, N 36 18', E 114 37', altitude 75 m) from May to October 2020. A randomized block design was used to perform the FIELD EXPERIMENTS, with 20 m2 for each plot... Starting 7 days after anthesis, SAME-AGED PANICLES of similar sizes were HARVESTED every 7 days, up to day 42 (T1-T6). | "The total RNA of the KERNELS of each panicle was extracted using TRIzol Reagent". The harvested panicles come straight from the field plots and the sequenced tissue is their kernels; the paper contains no greenhouse, growth chamber, pot or post-harvest treatment step. Replaces an automated same-sentence match. The archive held 'China: China:Anyang', a doubled prefix on an archive-only value.
